caption: A lighthouse beam sweeps around in the night, lighting up the sea and cliffs in turn as it passes.

sa.check: It lights up the sea and cliffs as it passes.
The sea and the cliffs are lit in turn, one after the other.

pc.expect: Each part of the scene brightens only as the beam crosses it and darkens again after.
pc.fail: A patch stays lit after the beam has passed; or brightens before the beam arrives; or the whole scene is lit at once.

pc.expect: The beam rotates steadily and the lit patch moves with it.
pc.fail: The beam stops and starts; or reverses; or the lit patch moves while the beam is still.

pc.expect: The beam is one straight cone from the lamp.
pc.fail: It bends; or splits into several; or it is a flood in all directions.

pc.expect: The lit patch sweeps one way round.
pc.fail: It jumps; or sweeps the opposite way to the beam; or moves crosswise.
A second beam appears; or the lighthouse vanishes; or the beam becomes solid.

pc.expect: The cliffs and the sea stay the same.
pc.fail: The cliffs change shape; or the sea changes; or the beam changes colour.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
